id: 16_Basic Electrical Engineering laboratory Viva Questions on Measurement of single
title: 电工实验口试：单相功率篇
source_doc: course/Basic Electrical Engineering Lab/16_Basic Electrical Engineering laboratory Viva Questions on Measurement of single.md
author_source: project/Basic Electrical Engineering Lab/16_Basic Electrical Engineering laboratory Viva Questions on Measurement of single/src.py

points.K6: 电阻负载功率因数为一

shots.scene: 欣欣坐在考官桌后，桌上摆着四盏小灯和一块功率表
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot sits behind an examiner's desk with four small lamps and a wattmeter on it, waving at the camera.
shots.narration: 口试第三关：单相功率！
overlay: 电工实验口试：单相功率篇

shots.scene: 阿杰对着电费单发呆
shots.prompt_en: The young male student stares at a blank electricity bill at home, puzzled.
shots.narration: 阿杰看着电费单：度是什么？

shots.scene: 小研笑着说口试正好要考
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student smiles and points at a blank question card.
shots.narration: 小研说：这正是口试要考的。

shots.scene: 四种灯和功率表图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of four lamp types and a wattmeter. No people.
shots.narration: 测灯具功率，其实就是单相功率测量。

shots.scene: 实验手册空白页旁三种灯图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank lab manual page beside icons of a compact fluorescent lamp, an LED lamp and an incandescent bulb. No people.
shots.narration: 手册里可能写成测节能灯、LED的功率。

shots.scene: 做功图标除以时钟图标
shots.prompt_en: A work icon divided by a clock icon. No people.
shots.narration: 功率是功除以时间，就是做功的快慢。

shots.scene: 灯泡旁一个空白单位牌
shots.prompt_en: A light bulb with a small blank unit tag beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 功率的单位是瓦。

shots.scene: 白板上写着公式
shots.prompt_en: A whiteboard with a single-phase power formula written in symbols. No people.
shots.narration: 单相功率等于电压乘电流乘功率因数。

shots.scene: 公式旁一个对勾和空白标签
shots.prompt_en: The formula with a green check and a blank tag beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 这样算出的是有功功率。

shots.scene: 功率表图标，四个端子
shots.prompt_en: A wattmeter icon with four terminals. No people.
shots.narration: 单相功率用功率表来测。

shots.scene: 粗线圈串联、细线圈并联
shots.prompt_en: Inside the wattmeter icon: a thick coil in series with the load and a thin coil across it. No people.
shots.narration: 一组是电流线圈，一组是电压线圈。

shots.scene: 细线圈高亮，旁边一个空白标签
shots.prompt_en: The thin coil highlights with a blank tag beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 电压线圈也叫压力线圈。

shots.scene: 电压波形和电流波形错开一个角度
shots.prompt_en: A voltage wave and a current wave shifted by an angle, with the angle marked. No people.
shots.narration: 功率因数：电压电流夹角的余弦。

shots.scene: 功率三角形：底边、竖边、斜边
shots.prompt_en: A power triangle: base for real power, vertical side for reactive power, hypotenuse for apparent power. No people.
shots.narration: 也是有功功率除以视在功率。

shots.scene: 阻抗三角形：电阻和阻抗
shots.prompt_en: An impedance triangle with resistance on the base and impedance as the hypotenuse. No people.
shots.narration: 还可以是电阻除以阻抗。

shots.section_title: 电阻负载功率因数为一
shots.scene: 电阻负载上电压电流波形重合
shots.prompt_en: For a resistor icon, the voltage wave and current wave overlap exactly. No people.
shots.narration: 纯电阻负载，电压电流同相。
overlay: 电阻负载功率因数为一

shots.section_title: 电阻负载功率因数为一
shots.scene: 表盘指针指在 1
shots.prompt_en: A power factor scale with the pointer at 1. No people.
shots.narration: 夹角为零，功率因数等于一。

shots.scene: 电能变成灯光和热的图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of electric energy turning into light and heat in a bulb. No people.
shots.narration: 有功功率：真正被用掉的功率。

shots.scene: 能量箭头在电源和线圈之间来回往返
shots.prompt_en: Energy arrows bouncing back and forth between a power source and a coil. No people.
shots.narration: 无功功率来回交换，不被消耗。

shots.scene: 公式卡片
shots.prompt_en: A blank formula card with reactive power symbols. No people.
shots.narration: 但它也是必需的，等于UIsinφ。

shots.scene: 一本合上的教材，书签夹在后面
shots.prompt_en: A closed textbook with a bookmark far toward the back. No people.
shots.narration: 无功补偿，以后的课程会学。

shots.scene: 功率三角形斜边高亮
shots.prompt_en: The hypotenuse of the power triangle highlights. No people.
shots.narration: 视在功率：电压有效值乘电流有效值。

shots.scene: 勾股定理图示
shots.prompt_en: A right triangle with squares on its sides illustrating the Pythagorean relation. No people.
shots.narration: 也等于有功、无功的平方和开根号。

shots.scene: 电动机图标，电流波形落后于电压波形
shots.prompt_en: An induction motor icon with a current wave lagging behind the voltage wave. No people.
shots.narration: 电动机这类感性负载，功率因数滞后。

shots.scene: 电容图标，电流波形超前
shots.prompt_en: A capacitor icon with a current wave leading the voltage wave. No people.
shots.narration: 容性负载，功率因数超前。

shots.scene: 老周指着电容图标，比出向上的手势
shots.prompt_en: The older man points at the capacitor icon and gestures upward.
shots.narration: 原片说：容性电路功率因数高。

shots.scene: 电动机旁并联一个电容
shots.prompt_en: An induction motor icon with a capacitor connected in parallel beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 负载旁并联电容，能提高功率因数。

shots.scene: 静电电容器、同步调相机、进相机三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a static capacitor, a synchronous condenser machine and a phase advancer machine. No people.
shots.narration: 静电电容器、同步调相机、进相机。

shots.scene: 变电站旁一排电容器组
shots.prompt_en: A row of capacitor bank cabinets near a substation fence. No people.
shots.narration: 变电站的电容器组，就是干这个的。

shots.scene: 低功率因数的线路发热、浪费图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a power line with heat waves and wasted energy symbols, marked with a warning. No people.
shots.narration: 功率因数低，线路损耗大，不划算。

shots.scene: 阿杰简洁作答，老周点头
shots.prompt_en: The young male student answers briefly and confidently; the older man nods.
shots.narration: 口试回答简明扼要，抓住要点。

shots.scene: 螺旋形节能灯剖面图标
shots.prompt_en: A cutaway icon of a spiral compact fluorescent lamp showing electrodes at the ends and a coated inner wall. No people.
shots.narration: 节能灯是紧凑型荧光灯。

shots.scene: 灯管内壁发出白光
shots.prompt_en: Small particles fly from the electrodes and strike the coated inner wall, which glows white. No people.
shots.narration: 电子撞上管壁荧光粉，发出白光。

shots.scene: 发光二极管图标亮起
shots.prompt_en: A light-emitting diode icon glowing. No people.
shots.narration: LED，发光二极管，也常被问到。

shots.scene: 功率表铭牌上标着量程和满刻度
shots.prompt_en: A wattmeter with a blank rating plate showing only range symbols. No people.
shots.narration: 功率表常数，参数都标在表上。

shots.scene: 读数乘以常数
shots.prompt_en: A meter reading icon multiplied by the number 2 equals a larger result. No people.
shots.narration: 读数乘常数，才是实际功率。

shots.scene: 四盏灯下方柱形：白炽灯最高，LED 最低
shots.prompt_en: Four lamp icons with bars beneath: the incandescent bar is tallest, the LED bar is shortest. No people.
shots.narration: 白炽灯最费电，LED最省电。

shots.scene: 白炽灯旁功率因数接近 1，LED 旁标滞后
shots.prompt_en: The incandescent lamp icon with a power factor scale near 1; the LED icon with a lagging wave. No people.
shots.narration: 白炽灯功率因数接近一，LED滞后。

shots.scene: 电表图标和空白电费单
shots.prompt_en: An electricity meter icon next to a blank electricity bill. No people.
shots.narration: 度是电能的计量单位。

shots.scene: 一千瓦的电器工作一小时图示
shots.prompt_en: A 1000-watt appliance icon next to a clock showing one hour, equals one unit. No people.
shots.narration: 一千瓦用一小时，就是一度电。

shots.scene: 电能等于功率乘时间的图示
shots.prompt_en: A diagram: a power icon multiplied by a clock icon equals an energy icon. No people.
shots.narration: 电能等于功率乘时间。

shots.scene: 电池图标和闪电速度图标
shots.prompt_en: Two icons: a full battery for energy and a speedometer for power. No people.
shots.narration: 电能是做功的本领，功率是快慢。

shots.scene: 100 瓦和 60 瓦两盏灯，100 瓦更亮
shots.prompt_en: Two bulbs side by side, the one marked 100 brighter than the one marked 60. No people.
shots.narration: 同样电压，100瓦灯更亮。

shots.scene: 公式卡片：电压平方除以电阻
shots.prompt_en: A formula card showing power equals voltage squared over resistance. No people.
shots.narration: 功率越大，灯丝电阻越小。

shots.scene: 阿杰举手提问，老周回答
shots.prompt_en: The young male student raises his hand; the older man answers with a smile.
shots.narration: 有疑问就问，下集再考下一个实验。

shots.scene: 功率三角形和功率表图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a power triangle and a wattmeter. No people.
shots.narration: 有功、无功、视在，功率因数三种说法。

shots.scene: 四盏灯、电表和电费单图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of four lamps, an electricity meter and a blank bill. No people.
shots.narration: LED最省电，一度电是一千瓦时。

shots.scene: 阿杰拿着电费单笑着和欣欣挥手
shots.prompt_en: The young male student holds a blank electricity bill, smiling and waving with the panda mascot.
shots.narration: 口试稳稳拿下，下次见！
